description: This Java source file defines a handler class for processing deposit commands on fixed deposit accounts within the Fineract microfinance platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, is annotated with Spring stereotypes, and delegates deposit logic to the DepositAccountWritePlatformService.
